Sam (CSM): Kestrel sent over a vendor risk form with SOC2 + DPA + custom encryption questions. They want answers before onboarding tomorrow. Can someone own KMS/proof + data residency? deadline EOD
Tara (Privacy): I can take the DPA clauses. Do we have an approved BYOK wording? :thinking_face:
Lee (Security): We don't support BYOK on hosted plans by default — BYOK is available for Dedicated/Private deployments. Suggested short wording below. :memo:
Lee (Security): ```We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and customer HSMs. Hosted API uses platform-managed keys; pseudonymization and tokenization options available on request.```
Jordan (AE): Heads up — their renewal is in ~60 days. If encryption/KMS is a blocker, proposing a short Dedicated trial usually helps the deal.
Sam (CSM): I will attach the SOC2 cover letter and a redacted report to the ticket. Henry, can you prepare proof of EU-only routing? They asked specifically about EU data residency.
Henry (Onboarding): We have region-pin config for customers. For hosted accounts we can route inference to eu-central by request; need infra to flip the flag and provide a control-plane audit. I'll open a ticket to infra now. ETA 24h.
Tara (Privacy): They will also ask for subprocessors list and data flow. I'll pull the latest subprocessors sheet and the data-flow diagram and add a short blurb for the DPA answers. Link I'll use: https://confluence.redwood.internal/subprocessors (will paste final)
ops-bot: New ticket created: CS-8472 - region pin + infra evidence (created by Henry)
Sam (CSM): Plan: Tara owns DPA wording + subprocessors, Lee owns security Qs (BYOK wording + KMS proof), Henry owns infra pin + region evidence, Jordan will prep renewal playbook / Dedicated trial offer. I'll compile and send back to Kestrel by EOD. Anyone want to pair on the BYOK wording?
Lee (Security): I can jump in for 30m after stand to review wording.
Jordan (AE): I'll draft trial pricing and a short note on SLAs. Will post draft here in ~2h. :eyes:
Tara (Privacy): I'll update the subprocessors list and DPA snippets, then drop a short FAQ for common questions (KMS, residency, retention).
Sam (CSM): Awesome — thanks team. Attaching SOC2 redacted now. Will follow up with final bundle in this thread. :thumbsup:
